quand: When the designer moves the order to the “Ready” step: the piece is finished and about to leave.
preheader: Finished, it is waiting for its tissue paper.

suivi.description: The order tracking link (no account needed)

retrait.description: Filled in when the client collects her piece from the atelier

blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

Your piece is finished. The designer has checked it seam by seam, and it is now waiting for its tissue paper and its certificate of authenticity.
We will write to you on the day it leaves, with the carrier’s tracking number.
It is waiting for you at the atelier. We will write to you to choose the day together.
You can follow your order {commande} here: {suivi}

Until very soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
